item.title: Buchnevich scores late in third period to help Blues end 10-game road skid with 3-1 win over Wild
item.description: Pavel Buchnevich scored late in the third period and the St. Louis Blues snapped a 10-game road losing streak by beating the Minnesota Wild 3-1. Logan Mailloux and Alexey Toropchenko also scored for St. Louis and Joel Hofer stopped 22 shots. Kirill Kaprizov scored to tie Marian Gaborik for the most goals in Wild franchise history with 218.
